notes.title: Cattle Country: Beneath and Beyond Update
notes.content: [p]Howdy Pardners! We fixin' to serve you sumthin' real good. We've been really putting our backs to it and are finally ready to [b]launch the first Cattle Country content update[/b]. This update will take exploring the Mine to whole new depths while also improving the life on the ranch.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to the Cattle Country community for your continuous feedback and suggestions. Y'all are square shooters in our books.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="zeC9Ri9Xlqo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Full list of new content, fixes and quality of life improvements in the latest game update can be found below.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]MINING RELATED[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Repeatable Town Project – Fire In The Hole. Causes a reset of mine. Unlocks after Jeb’s third heart cutscene.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Drill added for faster digging. Unlocks at Mining Level 10. Player will receive a letter about it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Scavenger Anvil added. Breaks down items to reclaim some components. Unlocks at Mining Level 6.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Players have a % chance to encounter Clickable Mine Objects in the mine with loot ranging from mine torches, ladders, platforms, elevators, dynamite to Ores, processed goods, crops, seeds, coins etc.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Mining helmet auto-equips in the mines and swaps back when leaving.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][u][b]MISCELLANEOUS[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Hay Dropper added. Auto-feeds hay for livestock. Unlocks at Farming Level 8.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Scratch Post added. Place in a barn or coop to keep animals happy (simulates player petting the animals). Unlocks at Farming Level 9.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Aquariums added to put your fish in. Small unlocked on Fishing Level 2. Medium unlocked on Fishing Level 5. Large unlocked on Fishing Level 8.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Play a tune to summon your horse. Unlocks once a player has built a stable and obtained your own horse.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] – Added walleye fish to lakes in spring/fall. It was previously uncatchable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Added letters that inform the player of items they have already unlocked, from this update.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Town Hall shows previews of needed donation items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Emily now sells seeds out of season. Player must unlock the greenhouse first.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Maggie sends you a letter if items block house upgrades.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][u][b]GENERAL FIXES AND QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p][b]CRASH FIX[/b] – During Pattie 1 if player finished dialogue while throwing plate on the table the game would require a restart.[/p][/*][*][p][b]CRASH FIX[/b] – The game would crash if you used the mine whistle while climbing a ladder.[/p][/*][*][p][b]CRASH FIX[/b] - Checking the map while Wild Will was inside a building would crash the game, e.g. Pattie 3.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX / NEW CONTENT[/b] – Put egg or turkey egg into crock pot to make mayonnaise.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX / NEW CONTENT[/b] – Add corn to the mill to make cornmeal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX / NEW CONTENT[/b] – Add beets to the mill to make sugar.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Could not complete the boxcar race after year 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Yams took 8 days instead of 11 days like they said they should, switched to 11 days.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Jim 3 cutscene in saloon had duplicate animations / objects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Post office should have been open on Saturdays.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Mayor Archibald now says the correct name of your animal at the end of the livestock fair, if you win.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] - Sometimes the Secret Santa would mess up the people and not work.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – If you gave your Secret Santa a gift before the winter feast, you could not give them a gift during the festival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Player horse colour changing during cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Ho ho ho, if you quit Winter Feast early, Jim would stay in his Santa costume.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] - Winter graphic overlays didn't delete when you removed a piece of equipment in the winter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Crafting buff did nothing, now gives you a 10% chance of making 2 items for the cost of 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] - Fixed the Winter Feast donation box on controller.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Fixed still wearing clothing while riding the horse naked.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Added potassium nitrate to the mines. It was previously very difficult to get.[/p][/*][*][p][b]BUG FIX[/b] – Fixed the general store sale items discount transferring to the buy tab.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – You get a letter the day of the Winter Feast informing you of who your Secret Santa is.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Expanded the capacity of the level 3 and 4 water cans.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Empty water barrels sold at general store during the spring.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Mill take 1 in-game hour to make flour/sugar/cornmeal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Added default recipe for grilled animal meat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Shipping box and chest graphics show open frame when hovering over them with your mouse[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – Bank pays out your earned interest into your account on the 1st of every month.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT[/b] – All seeds available at the general store restock on Mondays after player has built a greenhouse.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 25.6.3
notes.content:
Boy howdy, another one?!

The work hasn't slowed down in the workshop and here's another set of them fixes and updates for ye.

To our players on the other platforms, we appreciate the frustrations around PC patches going live while waiting on consoles to catch up but we want to reassure you that we are working as fast as we can to get all the platforms synced up and apologise that there are still issues on consoles. The reason consoles are dragging behind is the lengthier submissions processes compared to PC, varying from 2 days to 2 weeks, while Steam allows developers to publish patches whenever they are ready.

[h3]Full list of fixes and updates[/h3]

[list]
[*][b] Fixed glitch[/b] - Slide stuck on the left side of the town map
[*][b] Fixed furnace[/b] - If you put less than 5 sand in a furnace, on the "requires 5" ticker message it showed a picture of clay
[*][b] Butcher resource glitch[/b] - If you took your animals to the butcher and then closed the game before picking them up, when you next visited the butcher to pick up your resources there wouldn't be any
[*][b] Fixed inventory discard[/b] - Sometimes you wouldn't be able to delete inventory items. Nothing would happen when you clicked the trash
[*][b] Fixed the 24 hour clock (for real)[/b] - The time would still show 24:00 at midnight instead of 0:00
[*][b]Fixed resource rewards from butchering[/b] - Butchering calves and chicks for ridiculous amount of resources is no longer possible
[*][b]Fixed animals restrictions in barns and coops[/b] - Players would be able to have more than 6 animals in their barn or coop if babies were born on the same day
[*][b]Fixed chick growth[/b] - Baby chicks no longer exclusively turn into white chickens
[*][b]Fixed calves growth[/b] - Baby calves no longer exclusively turn into white cows
[*][b]Fixed localisation issue[/b] - Resource names when butchering an animal weren't translating
[*][b]Fixed equipment pickups[/b] - If you had equipment on a carpet, there was a 50/50 chance you couldn't put anything in the equipment
[*][b]Fixed villager pause menu[/b] -  If you gave someone a present and you only had 1, the gift icon would not show up on the villagers pause menu
[*] Hold down right mouse button, or X on the controller, to take/move more than 1 on menus
[*] Worms won't spawn on tiled soil, making them untillable
[*] Removed Jane's "Kill 10 bandits" quest if the player has enemies turned off
[*] Stopped mushrooms from growing on trees with sappers
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 25.6.1
notes.content:
Howdy, Cowpokes!

A whole week of cozy life in the Wild West is already behind us. Hope yer tending them crops and feeding them chickens. Maybe there's even already some romance up in the air? We've been keeping our sleeves rolled up and hands dirty too and have another patch update to share with yous right now!


[h3]FULL LIST OF FIXES AND UPDATES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Improved player walk and horse speed[/b] - Both the player character and their horse now traverse the wilderness a little bit quicker.
[*] [b]Fixed game crash when hoeing out of bounds[/b] - The game would crash if the player used the upgraded hoe to hoe outside of the bounds of the map
[*] [b]Fixed rodeo crash[/b] - Rodeo suffered from the same crash as the Hoedown event where the game crashed if you spoke to someone after the event.
[*] [b]Fixed inventory crash[/b] - The game would crash if players held shift while pressing to reorganize their chest or inventory.
[*] [b]Fixed menu closure issues[/b] - Menu would randomly stop closing using P or ESD.
[*] [b]Fixed building duplication bug[/b] - Buildings no longer duplicate randomly when attempting to move them around.
[*] [b]Fixed relationship advancement[/b] - It previously took 2 heart levels worth of gifts to get to level 2 heart after auto-gaining level 1 from introductions. This is no longer the case.
[*] [b]Fixed R key and key reconfiguration[/b] - The R key is no longer used for both rotating chairs/sofas and changing rows in your inventory at the bottom of the HUD. Use keys Q and E to change rows in your inventory.
[*] [b]Fixed Maggie quest dialogue and controller issue[/b] - Maggie 3 hearts scene used to say craft 10 items in dialogue and description instead of 50. The scene also didn't work on controllers.
[*] [b]Fixed item duplication[/b] - If you had an item on the mouse when you close any menu, the item amount would be doubled and put back in your inventory
[*] [b]Fixed wine rack[/b] - When removing items from wine rack, using mouse, you could get anywhere from 1-14 bottles back
[*] [b]Fixed gin icon[/b] - Gin showed the wrong icon on the distiller pop-up
[*] [b]Fixed inventory chest stacking issue[/b] - Sometimes items in your inventory chest would become unstackable, two of the same item with the same quality could not be combined
[*] [b]Fixed unlimited bull riding gifts[/b] - The player could get unlimited bull riding gifts. 
[*] [b]Fixed bull achievement requirements[/b] - Ride the bull achievement was set to 60 seconds to obtain but the description says 30 seconds. The requirement has been changed to 30 seconds.
[*] [b]Fixed achievement bug[/b] - The mayor's gifts for donating were not working properly, causing players to be unable to complete the achievement.
[*] [b]Fixed tool upgrading[/b] - If you upgraded a tool, pickaxe for example, and had a lower quality pickaxe in your inventory, it would combine tools and override to the lower one
[*] [b]Fixed chocolate bar cooking cost[/b] - Chocolate bars had no cooking costs and could be made for free and sold for 220g.
[*] [b]Fixed glass making[/b] - Players couldn't make glass in the furnace (5 sand + 1 coal).
[*] [b]Fixed tree seeds[/b] - Tree seeds no longer result in the wrong tree type, for example apple tree seeds turning into lemon trees.
[*] [b]Fixed 24hr clock[/b] - Midnight is now shown as 0:00 instead of 24:00.
[*] Added range overlay to scarecrows and sprinklers.
[*] Gain a speed buff once a day from using the outhouse.
[*] Number of birds per map have been reduced.
[*] Store open hours added - Click on the store doors to see their opening hours (when closed).
[*] Building tooltips added to the pause map
[*] Sight line added for guns when using a controller
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 25.5.28
notes.content:
Howdy pardners!

Hope you are enjoying your cozy Wild West life so far! We been busy gathering your feedback, replicating bugs and figuring out them fixes for ya. And lo' and behold, we have the first post-launch patch live [b]RIGHT NOW[/b], addressing some issues flagged by the community.

[h3][b]Full list of fixes in this patch[/b]:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed localisation bug - The game no longer stops player from progressing after reaching farming level 3 when playing with the Japanese language.
[*] Fixed cutscene - Patients from scene 3 with Andrew no longer get trapped in the Dr's office after the scene is completed.
[*] Fixed backspace on SteamDeck - Backspace now works on SteamDeck.
[*] Fixed SFX - There is no longer a chance that the elevator SFX never stops playings.
[*] Fixed unbreakable stumps - The game no longer shows the interaction hand icon that caused some tree stumps to be unbreakable.
[*] Fixed moving building kit issues - Controller issues have now been fixed and buildings should no longer phantom duplicate randomly when moving them.
[*] Fixed second rodeo ride - Game no longer softlocks after 50 seconds.
[*] Fixed tree and mushroom growth - Trees and mushrooms now regrow normally after enough time passes.
[/list]
If an issue you have reported is not on the list above, rest assured that we continue to log bugs posted on the Steam Community and on Discord and are working on fixing them as soon as we can!

This same patch update will be coming to Xbox this week and PS5 and Nintendo Switch in the next week or so.

notes.title: A new farming sim has entered the ring, except you're a cowboy on a ranch and you have shootouts with bandits and rob trains
notes.content: Cattle Country, a new addition to the farming sim space, has released on Steam. But to set it apart from what I'd say is a completely oversaturated genre, it strays from your standard routine as a farmer and puts you into the boots of a cowboy. If that's not enough to convince you to check it out, Arthur Morgan's voice actor, Roger Clark, narrates the launch trailer. Which, yes, is a selling point... Read more.

notes.title: Stardew Valley and Red Dead Redemption unite in new Wild West life game, out now
notes.content:
It was probably inevitable that a game like Cattle Country would be made. The runaway success of Stardew Valley, which put a new spin on farming games like Harvest Moon, has seen the simulation subgenre resurgent, with projects ranging from Coral Island to Dreamlight Valley finding large audiences in recent years. It's only natural, then, that a historical take on farming games would follow, with the Western American focus of Cattle Country offering a suitable setting. Now, after anticipating the project for nearly a year, Cattle Country has just launched on Steam.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Cattle Country open beta lets you try the Wild West farming game for free
Cattle Country is a cozy cowboy game with an Arthur Morgan trailer

notes.title: Huntin' & Fishin' in Cattle Country!
notes.content:
Howdy, folks!

Life in Cattle Country is all about living off the of the land. Whether you're tending to your farm, exploring the wilds or just kickin' back and watching nature around you, there's something for everyone!

Today we're taking a closer look at two frontier activities that'll help you thrive in Hill Valley; Hunting and fishing!

[h3]Combat? Optional! [/h3]

First things first, player choice is important, so you've got options to choose just how cozy you want Cattle Country to feel!

While the game does feature guns, their use is entirely up to you! We’ve given players the option to toggle enemies in both the overworld and the mines. This means that if you’re not looking for trouble, you can farm and explore without worrying about the risk of getting caught up in any hostile situations. 

But if you are in the mood for some action, just flip the switch and keep an eye out for bandits on your afternoon strolls. It’ll keep things interesting! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/eaed571578336af361863b77e46bca4d3b2d6ba7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Huntin'[/h3]

Now, let’s talk hunting. In Cattle Country, you don’t have to take up arms if you don’t want to. But if you decide to "live off the fat of the land" and hunt, don’t expect anything too brutal. We’ve designed hunting to fall under what we like to call "cozy combat" so no blood, no gore. Every critter or enemy you take down simply disappears in a little puff of smoke!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/1f87e20adeeffdc1a03a8d672267abe41be1a7d0.gif[/img]

When it comes to weapons, if you’re after small, quick critters, good luck using a gun! A bow and steady aim are your best friend here. Quiet, methodical movements are key, and that’s what makes hunting in Cattle Country such a rewarding experience!

[h3]Shootin' Contests[/h3]

Now, what would a true cowboy experience be without a little friendly competition? We’ve got several shooting mini-games where you can test your aim and prove you’ve got what it takes to be the fastest finger in town. And don't worry, these contests are 100% non-lethal! The townsfolk are safe for now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/92baae52239d2b470e0e70a7c843b3d0a82497c0.gif[/img]

[h3]Fishin' [/h3]

For those of you who like to take it easy, there are fishing spots scattered all over the map. Catching fish ain't a quick endeavour, but that’s part of the beauty of it. You’ll need time, patience, and a good sense of tranquillity to reel in those big ones. Plus, it's the perfect way to soak in the atmosphere of Hill Valley, whether you're enjoying the sunset or just taking a load off. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/56ebcfa2eda9686dfdc01eb545116f6d0f4c9880.gif[/img]

We’ve had a few folks reach out with questions about how these activities fit into the game, and we hope this clears things up! Whether you’re hunting, fishing, or just exploring, we can't wait for you to experience everything Cattle Country has to offer.  

See you out there, Partner!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country/

notes.title: Meet Tom & Grace!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/6dee89914ea11f83cf59013a3387e4b8953418fc.gif[/img]

Tom is the first to step up when the town’s in trouble, whether it’s chasing down bandits or lending a hand to a neighbour in need!

He's keen to make this a settlement of calm and comfort for the townsfolk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/a7128fa57fba35c5129fff3cbe720fbbf226ae72.gif[/img]

Grace is Sheriff Tom's daughter, trying to find her place in the world after the loss of her mother

The pastures and forests of Cattle Country offer a beautiful setting to grow up in!

notes.title: Meet Jane & Henry!
notes.content:
Howdy folks! 

With a new demo rolled out for Steam Next Fest, which you can play right now by the way! Let's take a look at two more of the Hill Valley townsfolk you can befriend in Cattle Country!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/9cec36498a1331a3e505302c44e832472847c051.gif[/img]

[h3]Jane: Running from her past and looking for her future  [/h3]

Jane has a knack for trouble, but it’s not for lack of trying to set things right. With a past full of bad decisions and run-ins with the sheriff, she’s now determined to start fresh. For now, she’s really trying to keep her head down, but Jane’s struggle to escape her old life is always present. The question is, can she truly leave it behind, or will the past come knocking? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/3caa080818978e848c555ded972a2f92bed48663.gif[/img]

[h3]Henry: The heart of a musician [/h3]

Henry is known for his strong hands and steady work as a lumberjack, but there’s another side to him that few get to see. Between long days of chopping, he sometimes picks up his banjo and plays, however his shyness means he avoids playing where others might hear 

Play the Cattle Country demo as part of Steam Next Fest NOW and meet these fine folk for yourself!

notes.title: New Cattle Country Demo for Next Fest!
notes.content:
Howdy folks!

It's demo season round these parts as Steam Next Fest rolls into town again with new wares to peddle and Cattle Country is no different!

We're back with a new version of the Cattle Country demo, bringing some new additions, tweaks and fixes. So whether you've been round here before or you're new, let's see what awaits you in this new frontier, eh?

notes.title: Meet Jeb & Pattie!
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We're back with some more character introductions to help get you settled in Cattle Country!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/2c50f2efb3397ec35f7b06fdbcb34405be554096.gif[/img]

Jeb spends his days deep in the mines or panning in the rivers, chasing the dream of striking it rich. But for Jeb, it’s not just about wealth – it’s about family. Every nugget of gold he finds is a step closer to a better life for his sister Marie and her kids. He is determined to keep going, even if the odds are stacked against him. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/256ccaa63770a160cc74cfb1ecf62ebd82db5ab0.gif[/img]

notes.title: Mining preview: What's mined is yours!
notes.content:
Howdy folks!

As we continue to develop Cattle Country into the coziest, cowboy-iest farming/life-sim, we wanted to share some more details about an element of the game we think you'll love, mining!

[h3]What's mined is yours![/h3]

Ready to dig deep and make some serious cash? The mines in Hill Valley are a great place to gather resources. When you grab your pickaxe and head underground, the world changes. What starts as a top-down view of the wild frontier shifts to a side-on perspective, plunging you into the depths and giving your a new perspective on your dark surroundings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/6a8285962a2eb9f3ff07e3717e8ab9174f95c574.gif[/img]

When you arrive in Hill Valley, Jeb will be on hand to show you how to use dynamite, and get the most out of your underground adventures, so take his advice! It may be the difference between vast riches, getting lost or even worse, waking up at the Doctors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/ca2106be52b692c3dc3f56fae7e40376de4e3db0.gif[/img]

In the final game, mining will be a great way to explore and gather materials for crafting and other treasures but with the chance of reward also comes risk! We've now added a variety of enemies into the mines to watch out for on your descent! Look out for rats, spiders and even flying critters! You might wanna make use of the weapons at your disposal to ensure you can safely traverse the depths. 

We'll be sharing more elements of life in Cattle Country over the coming months, so hit the Wishlist button to stay tuned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country/

notes.title: Saddle up! Horses are coming to Cattle Country!
notes.content:
Howdy, folks!

We’ve got some exciting news: Horses are galloping into Cattle Country for the next Steam Next Fest! Whether you’re rounding up cattle, exploring the frontier, or just taking in the sights, there’s no better way to travel than with your very own loyal steed.

[b]Meet Your New Best Friend[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/41695e0cb48601a06adff553827e189d5b7a3024.gif[/img]

Every player will have the chance to welcome a horse to their farm. This isn’t just any horse—it’s your horse. You’ll get to name your new companion and make them a part of your ranching life. Treat them well, and they’ll be your steadfast partner through thick and thin.

In the full game, you'll need to craft a stable first, but for the Next Fest demo, you'll have a horse ready to go!

[b]Explore in Style[/b]

Say goodbye to slow walks across the prairie (Unless that takes your fancy, of course!) With your trusty steed, you’ll cover ground faster and explore Cattle Country in style. Whether you’re blazing trails or heading into town, everything’s better on horseback.

[b]Get Ready to Ride![/b]

Horses arrive in Cattle Country as part of February's Next Fest, so saddle up and get ready to ride into the frontier!

Stay tuned for more updates, and we’ll see you on horseback real soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country/

notes.title: Meet Archibald and Lizzie!
notes.content:
Howdy folks! 

It's time to meet another few of the fine folks that inhabit this cosy little settlement we're putting together! Starting with someone at the centre of it all, the mayor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/03d35585e8870690aa3477eadfbf2a0b40849e9f.gif[/img]

Mayor Archibald is the backbone of the town, a man whose love for his town drives everything he does. Though he’s getting on in years, his energy and determination are as strong as ever. Archibald’s vision is clear: to turn this frontier settlement into a thriving community. He’s always got an open ear for the concerns of his townsfolk and a firm handshake for newcomers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/1e1b9976bf131fb0362c838c9b6f36926981ce85.gif[/img]

Lizzie isn’t just a teacher in Cattle Country; she’s a force of nature. She’s determined to bring culture and refinement to a rugged land where gunpowder and grit usually rule the day. And don’t let her gentle appearance fool you—she’s strong in more ways than one. 

Lizzie is shaping up this rough and tumble town one lesson at a time! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country/

notes.title: Meet John and Sassy! - Demo ending this weekend!
notes.content:
Howdy folks!

I come with new character intros as well as news that the Cattle Country Demo will be shutting down for a little while after this weekend! So get your mining done, finish picking those crops and say your goodbyes to your favourite settlers for now!

We'll be back with an updated demo for Steam Next Fest in February with some exciting addtions ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/30eaaabd9c3b0ebbed84179471bceabb80048908.gif[/img]

John, the blacksmith, is one of the hardest workers in Cattle Country. You’ll find him in his forge, hammering away at horseshoes, tools, and anything else the town needs. But look a little closer, and you’ll see he’s carrying a weight. Will you dig a little deeper and hear his story?  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/34f94a2aa4c1c1e8f25f9939d00d1422dbbe513d.gif[/img]

Sassy is a true survivalist, living off the land and keeping away from the chaos of town. She’s not the easiest person to approach, especially if you’re a stranger, but, once you earn her trust, you’ll find a heart of gold under that tough-as-nails exterior. 

Sassy has a keen survival instinct and knows a thing or two about foraging so keep as mush-room as possible in your day to spend time with this free spirit.

notes.title: Meet Carrie and Carl!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/02c20a9cd28a078755fa8d565c217dd56bc0c240.gif[/img]

Carrie, the saloon owner, isn’t fazed by the whispers, but this could be a dead end for business! 👀

Carl, the town banker, may be sharp with his books, but he’s certainly acting a bit strange… Makes you wonder: is he hiding something, or is it just the stress of counting so many dollars? Could Carl’s nerves be a sign of something bigger?

Good day, Playtonic Friends game enjoyers!

Do you happen to have a penchant for cozy games? Of course you do! What better way to escape the persistent horrors of reality than by fully immersing yourself in the fictional whimsy of another world?! 

Coincidentally, in support of this, and our good friend capitalism, a number of (Four, to be precise) Playtonic Friends titles are taking part in the Cozy Quest Steam event, run by our pals at Secret Mode! 

Let's have a wee gander at what games we're serving to you on a Cozy platter!

[h3]Cattle Country (Open Beta)[/h3]

Play Cattle Country's Open Beta for FREE! It's only running for until the 18th of November so go make the most of that one right now! Travel to a new frontier and settle down among the forests and rivers of Cattle Country, build up your ranch, nurture crops and relationships with your fellow settlers and see what the quieter country life is all about. This one is perfect for fans of farming sims with a cowboy twist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country

Okay, a bit of introduction... Lil Gator Game places you in charge of, wait for it, a cute Lil Gator, on a journey of adventure and friendship, often combing the two! (Friendventure?) Take on cardboard cut-out "monsters", gather your friends and finally get to play together!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1586800/Lil_Gator_Game/

Join Lily and slash your way through monster-infested dungeons to save the Kingdom of Blossom from eternal darkness. It's a lot cozier than that sounds... I promise.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/446810/Blossom_Tales_The_Sleeping_King/

Golf is sport and sport doesn't sound all that cozy or relaxing to me BUT A Little Golf Journey is here to subvert all of my preconceptions! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232150/A_Little_Golf_Journey/

notes.title: Cattle Country open beta lets you try the Wild West farming game for free
notes.content:
As good as its story is, my favorite moments of Red Dead Redemption 2 are the quiet ones. Spending time in camp, wandering the wilds of the Old West, hunting for food, taking care of my horse, or running a moonshine shack in the online mode. Cattle Country, then, is a game that holds a lot of appeal to me. It takes the tried and tested farming sim formula popularized by Stardew Valley and transports it to a world of cowboys and bandits, even sprinkling in a little Terraria-style mining for good measure. Interested? You can try it now for free, thanks to a new open beta on Steam.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Cattle Country is a cozy cowboy game with an Arthur Morgan trailer

notes.title: Cancel your weekend plans because this cozy cowboy life sim just went into open beta and you can play it for free

And he only occasionally shot a few bandits and cattle rustlers... Read more.

notes.title: Cattle Country Closed Beta - What To Expect!
notes.content:
Howdy, folks (I'm never gonna get bored of starting these with "Howdy")

We're rollin' on up on Beta time and wanted to give y'all a quick nudge to [b]check your emails if you signed up to take part in the Closed Beta[/b], we still have a number of folks who haven't responded to us and we need to ensure you're ready to take part! 

[h2]What can you expect from the Beta?[/h2]

The Closed Beta will feature a small slice of what you can expect from the full Cattle Country experience. The game is still in early development so this Beta will not represent the final scope or performance of the final product! 

You'll be able to create your character, manage your ranch, interact with a few local characters, and explore the early features of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/8e8d9434d613c66b58d54855cb6fd43222d95b88.png[/img]

You'll start by customizing your character, and naming your ranch, as well as meeting Mayor Archibald who will welcome you to the town, for the sake of saving a little time, he's even set up a small simple ranch to get you started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/39b8e1b920f6ed8f61a4311b40309067a3bfb71f.png[/img]

Mayor Archibald will then stay near by the ranch, ready to whisk you away to the Town Square or the Mines if you want to fast travel. However, if you would prefer to explore on foot there will be signposts dotted about to help you on your way!

You'll also be able to interact with, and befriend, a small handful of the characters planned for the full game who will have a variety of quests for you to potentially help with! These lovely folk are known as the Welcoming Committee; with Carl the bank teller, Sassy the outdoor expert, John the blacksmith, and Carrie who owns the saloon which... rumours have it might be haunted??

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077170/34d397ddea836d7e7b4c4660e297ea6e6082f9b2.png[/img]

This Beta is a chance to provide feedback. If you're invited to the Beta, you'll receive a feedback form, access to a Steam Discussion forum and a Discord space for your thoughts.
 
Don’t worry if you didn't manage to get into this round of Beta Testing — there will be more opportunities to play Cattle Country down the road!
 
We're lookin' forward to welcoming you to this little community of settlers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country/

notes.title: Saddle up for Cattle Country!
notes.content:
Howdy, folks!

Yesterday we announced through IGN that our next Playtonic Friends title is Cattle Country! A Wild West-inspired farming life-sim from our good friends at Castle Pixel, the very talented folks behind the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747830/Blossom_Tales_II_The_Minotaur_Prince/]Blossom Tales[/url] series!

Check out the reveal trailer below for an early look at the game!

[previewyoutube=-GV3QQnqGZo;full][/previewyoutube]

Set up camp on the outskirts of town and from there, build out and expand your ranch. Will you tend to cattle, focus on growing crops or a little of both? The choice is yours. From sunup to sundown, you'll be rollin' up your sleeves and gettin' your hands dirty workin' the land.

Head in to town and get to know the folk who call this place home, life here will be much more fulfilling with some friends around you! Of course, you might have to help a few folk out to break the ice but it'll be worth it in the long run. And with 18 romanceable characters, there's plenty of opportunity to take those friendships further and find yourself a partner, partner. Just remember, there are folk who still don't subscribe to the settled life, so keep your wits about you and protect your homestead.

And it ain't all just green fields and wooded forests, there's gold in these hills. Grab your pick and head out to the mines on a hunt for precious metals and minerals, or happen upon a Bandit stash if you're lucky/brave enough. There's plenty of wildlife out there in the fields too, whether you're huntin' for food or just looking to take in the sights of nature.

This is just a taste of what's to come when you throw down roots, so saddle up for plenty of adventure! Welcome to Cattle Country!

If you like what you see, please consider Wishlisting the game on Steam, it really helps us getting the game out there! And jump into the [url=https://discord.gg/PJnxtDVMeW]Playtonic & Friends Discord[/url] if you want more direct updates on Cattle Country!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country/
